caption: Every Friday, Wanjiru's chama puts in a thousand shillings each. This week, it's her turn.
spoken: Every Friday, Wanjiru's chama puts in a thousand shillings each. This week, it's her turn.

caption: But one treasurer collects it all, in cash or on one phone, and the whole group has to trust them.
spoken: But one treasurer collects it all, in cash or on one phone, and the whole group has to trust them.

caption: 8.7 million Kenyans save in groups like this.
spoken: Eight point seven million Kenyans save in groups like this.

caption: This is Zamu. Your chama, paid straight to M-Pesa.
spoken: This is Zamu. Your chama, paid straight to M-Pesa.

caption: This is the real app, inside Nimiq Pay on a phone. Open it from Mini Apps.
spoken: This is the real app, inside Nimiq Pay on a phone. Open it from Mini Apps.

caption: Sign in by signing a message with your own Nimiq key. Nobody types a password.
spoken: Sign in by signing a message with your own Nimiq key. Nobody types a password.

caption: Start a chama: the share, how often, how many, and the M-Pesa number your turn is paid to.
spoken: Start a chama: the share, how often, how many, and the M-Pesa number your turn is paid to.

caption: Ask for less than fifteen shillings, and Zamu says so before anything is saved.
spoken: Ask for less than fifteen shillings, and Zamu says so before anything is saved.

caption: Then share the invite code, or the QR code, with your group.
spoken: Then share the invite code, or the QR code, with your group.

caption: When everyone has joined, each member signs the agreement with their own Nimiq key.
spoken: When everyone has joined, each member signs the agreement with their own Nimiq key.

caption: Each round, members tap Pay. Nimiq Pay swaps their NIM or USDT to Lightning, and a payout partner turns it into exact shillings in Wanjiru's M-Pesa.
spoken: Each round, members tap Pay. Nimiq Pay swaps their NIM or U S D T to Lightning, and a payout partner turns it into exact shillings in Wanjiru's M-Pesa.

caption: A share only turns green when the M-Pesa receipt comes back, and the whole group can open it.
spoken: A share only turns green when the M-Pesa receipt comes back, and the whole group can open it.

caption: If Nimiq Pay can't tell whether a payment went out, Zamu never lets you pay twice. It checks, and waits.
spoken: If Nimiq Pay can't tell whether a payment went out, Zamu never lets you pay twice. It checks, and waits.

caption: And anyone who stops paying loses their turn until they catch up.
spoken: And anyone who stops paying loses their turn until they catch up.

caption: Under the hood, Nimiq Pay signs and pays. Zamu checks every invoice: Bitcoin mainnet, the exact amount, the right phone, still valid. A job on AWS keeps checking until the receipt arrives.
spoken: Under the hood, Nimiq Pay signs and pays. Zamu checks every invoice: Bitcoin mainnet, the exact amount, the right phone, still valid. A job on A W S keeps checking until the receipt arrives.

caption: On a live quote today, the payout leg cost one percent over the partner's own rate.
spoken: On a live quote today, the payout leg cost one percent over the partner's own rate.

caption: Real payouts are next, and every number will come from our proof script.
spoken: Real payouts are next, and every number will come from our proof script.

caption: Shares land in M-Pesa, not a group wallet. Paid means a receipt. Everyone signs with Nimiq. No treasurer holds the pot.
spoken: Shares land in M-Pesa, not a group wallet. Paid means a receipt. Everyone signs with Nimiq. No treasurer holds the pot.

caption: Friday again. Wanjiru's phone buzzes: five thousand shillings, and a receipt for every share.
spoken: Friday again. Wahn-jee-roo's phone buzzes: five thousand shillings, and a receipt for every share.

caption: Zamu. Open it in Nimiq Pay.
spoken: Zamu. Open it in Nimiq Pay.
